title: Page 8
content_zh:
“当然是当贼去了。”她白他一眼，把手伸到水里去吃他的豆腐，“挖那个大祭司的药田还需要跟他报备？”

文谨抚着额，“你也说了，那个人是大祭司，况且当小偷本来就不对……”

“只要能治好你，我管他是谁？我不在乎会结什么梁子。”她的两手在他身上摸来又摸去，很不满意她的专用豆腐变瘦了。

在烛光和水光的交映下，文谨这才清楚地看见她脸上掩饰不住的疲惫，他心疼地抚上她的芳颊。

“娘子，咱们改日补一补洞房花烛夜吧。”都看那么多本书了，该会的早就会了，不该会的，他也都学会了。

“行。”

他笑笑地看着她的大方样，“不嫌弃我了？”

“再嫌弃也是自家夫君嘛。”她微笑地扳着他的后颈，将他拉过来狼吻一顿，再恶狠狠地警告他，“所以别怪我先把丑话说在前头，日后你要敢出墙，我就动手宰了你。”

“夫人，你还是先把你的饿狼关好再说吧，不要逼我在日后为了正义与和平大义灭亲。”没节操的人又不是他。

看着他一副义正辞严的模样，月穹还是忍不住笑了出来，可没过一会儿，她蓦地笑意一僵，后知后觉地发出一声惨叫。

“啊！”

“怎么了？”

她用力拍着额际，“坏了，我忘了小七！”

比起完全将傅衡抛诸脑后的月穹，在她想起自家这号师弟之前，远在黄金门里，手握大批密探的蓬莱早已收到了密探传来的求援信。

看过消息的莫追躲在房柱边，不怎么敢上前靠近那个冷笑个不停的蓬莱。

“二师兄，你控制一下火气……”他这回要是再拆房子的话，大师兄一定会骂他败家的。

蓬莱撕碎了信纸，“云取宫当我黄金门的人是都死光了吗？”很好，先伤文谨，再关了小七？

他好不容易才为月穹找到个夫婿把她给嫁出门，他们以为，能够容忍月穹臭脾气的人，除了文谨外，天底下还找得出第二个吗？居然想毁了月穹的饭票？

还有他家的小七，他辛辛苦苦把小七拉拔大，养这只天生就阴险的孩子有多花功夫他们知道吗？更别说这孩子又特爱乱跑，通常一整年下来他也只见得着一次面而已，他都已多久没见到那个坏孩子了，他们竟还把他抓去关？

“眼下最重要的是先救出七师兄要紧……”莫追赶在他气炸前对他进谏。

蓬莱也不多罗唆，“小八，师门暂且交给你。”

“交给我？”干嘛推给他？

蓬莱自书柜上取下已多年没用过的大刀，再转身去吩咐外头的人为他准备战马。

莫追紧张地上前拉住他的衣袖，“二师兄，你打算上哪去？”

“出门松松筋骨，顺道去拎小七回家。”好久没砍人了。

“呃……”莫追怕怕地看着他状似平静的眼眸，“那大师兄要是问起来怎么办？”明明大师兄就说过，在他没有完成修身养性这一任务前是不准下山的。

蓬莱冷冽的眸光朝他一扫，“这事你是想让我出面，还是叫大师兄亲自出马？”

这个嘛……莫追情不自禁事先预想了一下结果。

二师兄去的话，血流成河。

大师兄去的话……人间炼狱。

他速速改口，“二师兄你一路顺风！”

“识相就好。”蓬莱拍拍他的脑袋，动作迅捷如风地去牵他的战马。

而让月穹和蓬莱都心心念念不已的傅衡，他的情况，其实并没有他们想像的那么糟，相反的，他就像只掉进米缸的老鼠，有点乐不思蜀。

轻而易举就钻，先是杀回墓穴搬光第二大祭司谋反用的工具，再回到秘庄搬空他的库房，搬得不过瘾之际，傅衡索性又再钻进地道，沿着地道一路找到云取宫去。

地道的出口处，就设置在云取宫第一大祭司的寝房里，既然他们都是谋反的同伙，傅衡也就不客气地将大祭司宫中的

在他偷完了第一大祭司宫中的宝物，正打算撤退时，他不小心又找到了大祭司的秘密库房。

望着满屋子的金银财宝，傅衡愉快地吹了声口哨。

“师姊，这回真是谢谢你了……”

急急忙忙赶去救小七的月穹，才火速赶至云取宫的范围外，她没想到，这回她连山也不必爬岭也不必翻，因为傅衡正带着身后一大票的追兵，飞快地朝山脚下的这个方向冲过来。

他在路过她时不忘跟她打声招呼。

“原来四师姊还记得我啊？”他还以为她的烂记性永远都想不起来。

她胡里胡涂地跟着他跑，“呃，事有轻重缓急嘛，一不小心就给忘了……”

“我这么个大活人也能忘了，那还真是不小心啊。”他边说边躲过身后射来的一柄暗器，手握着长弓回头就还了一箭。

“臭小子，少得了便宜还卖乖了！”月穹一路忙着撒毒药忙质问他，“说，你干了啥事？”后头最少也有上百人，这么大的阵仗，绝不可能只是挖了一座药田造成的。

他耸耸肩，“顺手拿了点东西而已……”

原本跑得像是赶着要投胎去的两人，在一阵乱起的烟尘中，突然双双停下脚步。

“你搬空了他家？”月穹在把他拦下来后，第一个念头就朝往例去想。

“是他们家。”傅衡也没再急着跑，只是一箭箭地往后头射。

她听得头大无比，“你不只偷了一个祭司？”

“他们既留我作客，自然就得付点代价。”把箭筒里的箭都射光后，他改拿出一袋飞镖。

这代价也太庞大了吧？瞧瞧他们都来了多少人啊？

“你是怎么搬的？”月穹把他的身子转过来转过去，就是没见他身上带有大包小包，也没看到任何战利品。

他亮出手上的戒指，“六师姊那个龟仙相公给我的见面礼。”听说是天界来的神物，目前可是他犯罪时的最好帮手。

“塞得下？”她很难相信这么一个小小的戒指竟能这么省事。

他意犹未尽地看着远方的山头，“再多也塞得下。”

“行了行了，别想着再回去搬了，多一事不如少一事。”月穹光看他的表情就知道他想做什么，忙拉着他的手带着他继续往前跑。

身后追赶着他们的追兵，眼看就要追不上已经使出轻功的他们，情急之下，他们只好发出烟火紧急求援。

“师姊。”傅衡注意到了那个求援讯号。

月穹索性也不跑了，打算在他们招来更多的人之前，先行解决掉眼前的人。她在那些由祭司们派出的教徒来到她的面前时，摊开两掌蓄力，再释放出相级中阶的威压镇住他们的脚步，傅衡见状随即往她的身后一躲。

势如破竹的内力像一柄镰刀，横扫过离他们最近的人，傅衡此时也冲出来收拾犹站着的教徒，只是当他们刚打理好这群人时，自山脚底下又冒出了一片密密麻麻的人海，简直就像是捅了马蜂窝似的。

傅衡有些错愕，“怎么来了那么多人？”

“这还不都怪你贪心？”月穹拎起他的衣领往最高的树上跳，使上了比他还要快的轻功，在树梢上不断狂奔。

就在他们一个跑着、一个挂着的这个当头，远远的，前方远处的平原上，出现了一人一马急驰而来的身影。

怎么……那身形看起来那么眼熟？

月穹单脚停在树梢上，愈看来者手就愈抖。

"Of course he became a thief." She rolled her eyes at him and put her hand into the water to eat his tofu. "Do I need to report to the high priest when digging his medicinal fields?"

Wen Jin stroked his forehead, "You also said that that person is the high priest, and besides, being a thief is wrong in the first place..."

"As long as he can cure you, I don't care who he is? I don't care what trouble he gets." She ran her hands over and over his body, dissatisfied that her special tofu had become thinner.

Under the reflection of candlelight and waterlight, Wen Jin could clearly see the exhaustion that could not be concealed on her face, and he caressed her cheeks distressedly.

"Madam, let's make up for the wedding night another day." He has read so many books, and he has already learned what he should know, and he has also learned what he shouldn't know.

"Okay."

He looked at her generosity with a smile, "Don't you dislike me?"

"No matter how much you dislike him, he is still her husband." She smiled and grabbed the back of his neck, pulled him over for a kiss, and warned him fiercely, "So don't blame me for saying ugly things first. If you dare to cheat in the future, I will kill you."

"Madam, you'd better lock up your hungry wolf first. Don't force me to kill my family for the sake of justice and peace in the future." He is not the one who has no moral integrity.

Seeing his righteous expression, Yue Qiong couldn't help but laugh, but after a while, her smile suddenly froze, and she let out a scream after realizing it.

"Ah!"

"What's wrong?"

She patted her forehead hard, "It's broken, I forgot about Xiaoqi!"

Compared to Yue Qiong, who completely forgot about Fu Heng, before she remembered her junior brother, Penglai, who was far away in the Golden Gate and had a large number of spies, had already received a letter asking for help from the spies.

Mo Zhui, who had read the news, hid by the pillars of the room, not daring to approach the sneering Penglai.

"Second Senior Brother, please control your anger..." If he demolishes the house again this time, Senior Brother will definitely scold him as a prodigal.

Penglai tore up the letter and said, "Are all the people who used my golden gate in Yuntori Palace dead?" Very good, hurt Wen Jin first, and then lock up Xiao Qi?

He finally found a husband for Yue Qiong to marry off. They thought that apart from Wen Jin, who could tolerate Yue Qiong's bad temper, could they find anyone else in the world?You actually want to ruin Yue Qiong’s meal ticket?

And his family's Xiao Qi, he worked so hard to raise Xiao Qi. Do they know how much effort it takes to raise this naturally sinister child?Not to mention that this kid loves to run around, and usually he only sees him once in a whole year. How long has it been since he saw that bad boy, and they actually arrested him and imprisoned him?

"The most important thing right now is to rescue the Seventh Senior Brother first..." Mo Chai admonished him before he exploded in anger.

Penglai didn't say much, "Xiaoba, I'll leave the division to you for the time being."

"Leave it to me?" Why push it to him?

Penglai took off the big knife that had not been used for many years from the bookcase, then turned around and ordered the people outside to prepare his war horse.

Mo Zhui stepped forward nervously and grabbed his sleeve, "Second Senior Brother, where are you going?"

"Go out to relax your muscles and bones, and take Xiaoqi home on the way." It's been a long time since I killed someone.

"Uh..." Mo Zhui looked at his seemingly calm eyes fearfully, "Then what if Senior Brother asks me?" Senior Brother Mingming had said that he was not allowed to go down the mountain before completing the task of cultivating his moral character.

Penglai's cold eyes glanced at him, "Do you want me to intervene in this matter, or do you want your senior brother to do it himself?"

Well... Mo Zhuiqing couldn't help but predict the outcome in advance.

If the second senior brother goes there, blood will flow like a river.

If Eldest Brother goes there... it will be hell on earth.

He quickly changed his words, "Second Senior Brother, you have a pleasant trip!"

"Just recognize it." Penglai patted his head and went to lead his horse as fast as the wind.

As for Fu Heng, who Yue Qiong and Penglai both missed, his situation was actually not as bad as they imagined. On the contrary, he was like a mouse that fell into a rice vat, a little happy and unwilling to miss Shu.

It was easy to get through, first he went back to the tomb to remove all the tools used by the second high priest for his rebellion, and then returned to the secret manor to empty out his warehouse. When he couldn't move enough, Fu Heng simply got into the tunnel again and followed the tunnel to find Yuntori Palace.

The exit of the tunnel was located in the dormitory of the first high priest of Yuntori Palace. Since they were all accomplices in the rebellion, Fu Heng unceremoniously removed all the people in the high priest's palace.

After he finished stealing the treasures in the palace of the first high priest and was about to retreat, he accidentally found the secret warehouse of the high priest.

Looking at the gold and silver treasures in the room, Fu Heng whistled happily.

"Sister, thank you very much this time..."

Yue Qiong, who hurried to save Xiao Qi, rushed outside the scope of Yuntori Palace. She did not expect that this time she would not even have to climb the mountain or climb over it, because Fu Heng was rushing towards the foot of the mountain with a large group of pursuers behind him.

He didn't forget to say hello to her when he passed her.

"So Fourth Senior Sister still remembers me?" He thought that her bad memory would never allow her to remember me.

She ran after him in a confused manner, "Well, there are priorities. I accidentally forgot..."

"It's really careless for a living person like me to forget it." He said as he dodged a hidden weapon shot from behind, turned around with a longbow in his hand and shot back an arrow.

"You bastard, you got a lot of money and you behaved well!" Yue Qiong was busy spreading poison along the way and asked him, "Tell me, what did you do?" There were at least a hundred people behind him. Such a huge battle could not be caused by just digging a medicine field.

He shrugged, "I just picked up something..."

The two people who were running as if they were rushing to be reincarnated suddenly stopped in a burst of smoke and dust.

"Did you vacate his house?" After Yue Qiong stopped him, her first thought was to think about the past.

"It's their house." Fu Heng didn't run away in a hurry, he just shot arrows in the back.

Her head was pounding, "Did you steal more than just one priest?"

"Since they keep me as a guest, they have to pay a price." After shooting all the arrows in the quiver, he took out a bag of darts.

Isn’t the price too high?Look how many people have come to them?

"How did you move it?" Yue Qiong turned his body around, but she didn't see any big or small bags on him, nor did she see any loot.

He showed the ring on his hand, "This is a meeting gift given to me by the turtle fairy husband of the Sixth Senior Sister." I heard that it is a divine object from the heaven, and it is currently his best helper when committing crimes.

"Can it fit in?" She found it hard to believe that such a small ring could be so trouble-free.

He looked at the mountains in the distance with unsatisfied eyes, "No matter how much, it can be crammed in."

"Okay, okay, don't think about going back to move again. One more thing is worse than one less thing." Yue Qiongguang knew what he wanted to do by looking at his expression, and hurriedly took his hand and led him to continue running forward.

The pursuers chasing them were about to be unable to catch up with them who had already used Qinggong. In desperation, they had no choice but to send out fireworks to urgently call for help.

"Sister." Fu Heng noticed the signal for help.

Yue Qiong simply stopped running and planned to get rid of the people in front of them before they recruited more people.When the believers sent by the priests came to her, she spread out her palms to gather strength, and then released the middle-level pressure to suppress their steps. Fu Heng immediately hid behind her when he saw this.

The overwhelming internal force was like a sickle, sweeping through the people closest to them. Fu Heng also rushed out to deal with the still standing believers. However, when they had just taken care of this group of people, a dense sea of ​​​​people emerged from the foot of the mountain, just like poking a hornet's nest.

Fu Heng was a little surprised, "Why are there so many people here?"

"Isn't this all your fault for being greedy?" Yue Qiong picked up his collar and jumped onto the tallest tree, using Qinggong that was faster than him, and kept running wildly on the treetops.

Just as one of them was running and the other hanging, in the distance, on the plain far ahead, a figure of a man and a horse appeared galloping towards them.

Why...that figure looks so familiar?

Yue Qiong stopped with one foot on the treetop, and the more he looked at it, the more his hands shook.
